newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Cargolux says no plans for Buenos Aires service.
newsitem.headline: Cargolux says no plans for Buenos Aires service.

text.p: Cargolux said industry reports sources suggesting it was planning to launch a Boeing 747 freighter service between Luxembourg and Buenos Aires were unfounded.
"We have no concrete plans to launch such a service and the reports are simply incorrect" Cargolux vice-president, sales and marketing Europe/Africa/Middle East, Pierre Wesner, told Reuters.
He added:"While South America is undoubtedly a growth market for air cargo, we don't want to proceed too quickly in our development in this region."
Last autumn,the Luxembourg-based all-cargo airline launched a weekly 747F service to the Chilean capital, Santiago.
It also operates a twice-weekly service to Sao Paulo in Brazil.

Commenting on January 1997 figures issued by the airline recently, which showed a 15 percent increase in freight tonne kilometres (FTK) flown on the same month in 1996, Wesner said: "The solid growth in traffic was largely due to a buoyant overall demand and we are hoping this can be maintained throughout the year." --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-542-7706 Fax 5017
